name: [🦵Break Your Legs] Trending Emote Dance
desc:
✨Welcome to Trending Emote Dance!

🎶 A dance game with 330+ Emotes to enjoy

🕺 Tap a player to sync and dance together

💎 Found an Emote you like
You can purchase your favorite Emotes and use them in Roblox!
All emote form Roblox Marketplace 🛍️

⭐ Thank you for playing Trending Emote Dance!
We’ll keep updating the game and doing our best

❤️ Have fun dancing with your friends!

llm.loop: join server -> try 330+ trending emotes -> tap players to sync dances -> buy favorite emotes from the Marketplace
llm.objectives: dance with friends and try out trending emotes
llm.instructions: dance with 330+ emotes, tap a player to sync, purchase emotes you like for use across Roblox
unique: emote try-on showroom monetized via Roblox Marketplace emote sales
monetization_signals: Marketplace emote purchases (no passes or products)
llm.thumbnails: anime girl 'EMOTE' icon; avatars posing on a flat baseplate showing emotes, 'i got that feeling' emote text
llm.complexity_notes: flat baseplate with emote catalog UI; reuses Marketplace animations
